about: docs/20 5.2: a retelling you dismissed was meant (a lie, a joke): nothing corrects it later.

card.name: Buffy
card.description: Buffy Summers, twenty, back in Sunnydale. Quick, guarded, funny.

history.content: At the curb outside the house, still in the car, Gabriel asks: "Have you ever had romantic feelings towards Spike?"
ledger: beat: In the car at the curb, Gabriel asks Buffy whether she ever had romantic feelings for Spike

history.content: "No. Never. And Dawn is hearing about this jealousy question at dinner," Buffy says, and gets out of the car.
ledger: promise Buffy → Gabriel: tell Dawn about the jealousy question at dinner | open [due 2001-10-11 15:05]
beat: Buffy says no, and promises to tell Dawn about the jealousy question at dinner

history.content: Inside, he gets the tools out.
The wrench turns. Gabriel fixes the kitchen faucet, sleeves rolled, biceps everywhere, while Buffy watches from the counter.
ledger: beat: Gabriel fixes the kitchen faucet while Buffy watches

history.content: We pick Dawn up and come home for tacos. "Go on, tell her the story," he grumbles.
Buffy grins. “Okay. So. This morning. Kitchen. He was fixing the faucet, biceps everywhere, and he asked me, and I quote, should I be jealous of Spike?”
